concerns.text: FR-003 (Train Random Forest), FR-004 (Extract Feature Importance), and SC-001/SC-003 (Measure performance) lack implementation tasks. Tasks T022, T023, and T024 are marked as missing/unchecked in the provided text, leaving the core modeling logic and metric calculation unimplemented.

FR-005 (Permutation testing), FR-006 (BH correction), FR-007 (Stratification), and SC-001/SC-002 (Validation metrics) are not fully covered. Tasks T029a, T029b, T031, T032, T033, and T034 are unchecked. Specifically, T029b (batch covariate adjustment) and T031 (Null Result logic) are critical for FR-007 and US-3 but lack implementation steps.

FR-002 (Imputation/Normalization) and US-1 acceptance scenarios are partially unimplemented. T012 (Categorical-to-ordinal conversion), T014 (Save raw data with checksum), and T015 (Save harmonized dataset) are unchecked, leaving data ingestion and harmonization incomplete.

FR-004 (Output CSV) and SC-005 (Feasibility check) lack tasks. T038 (Report generation), T039 (Null Result reporting), and T040 (Feasibility check) are unchecked, meaning the final output and constraint verification are not planned.

Task T009 references `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` which is listed in the plan as a Phase 1 output, but the task itself is unchecked. While the contract exists in the plan, the task to create it is missing from the execution list, creating a gap in the 'Setup' phase.

Tasks T030 and T035 are marked as [DEPRECATED] but remain in the task list. While not a functional gap, they clutter the execution plan and should be removed to maintain clarity, as per the 'Polish' phase goals.
